script.topic: Why most people never actually see compound interest

hook.text: Everyone quotes compound interest. Almost nobody lasts long enough for it to matter.
hook.broll_query: close-up of a growing stack of coins on a wooden desk

beats.text: The viral clip says a small monthly transfer becomes a fortune if you never interrupt it.
beats.broll_query: calendar pages flipping beside a savings jar

beats.text: Cliplytics only captured the creator's claim — not a verified return or time horizon.
beats.broll_query: person pausing a phone video mid-scroll

cta.text: Treat the numbers as a prompt to check, not as a fact.
cta.broll_query: notebook with a question mark next to a calculator

script.tiktok_caption: Compound interest only works if you actually stay invested. #finance #money
